title: Approval Flows
meta: Requests routed to the right person for a yes or no, with reminders and a record of every decision. From $100, delivered in 7 days or less.
h1: Approval flows that route requests to a decision
overview: Approvals stall when they live in email threads. We build a flow where a request, such as an expense, a time-off day or a discount, goes to the right person with the details, and they answer yes or no with one click. Reminders chase slow replies, the requester is told the outcome, and every decision is saved with a date for later checks.

pkgs.blurb: One request type routed to one approver, with a record.
list: One approver with yes and no buttons

pkgs.blurb: Several request types, reminders and routing by amount.
Multi-level approvals with limits, reports and a request form.
list: Monthly report of requests and times

faq: In email, Slack, Teams or a simple web page, whichever your team uses. It works on a phone too, so an approver on the move can answer in seconds.
What kinds of requests suit this?
Purchase and expense requests, time off, discount approvals, content sign-off, refund approvals and supplier onboarding. Any yes or no decision with a clear owner works well.
Can approvals depend on the amount?
Yes. For example, anything under a set amount goes to a manager and larger amounts also need a director. We write the rules down with you and test each path.
Is there a record for audits?
Every request is stored with the details, approver, decision and time. This is a business record for your own use, and it does not replace any legal or accounting requirement.
